name: Adam Schiff

lean.basis: Democratic congressman (2001–2024) and U.S. senator from California since December 2024.

summary: Adam Schiff represented a Los Angeles-area district in the House from 2001 to 2024, chaired the House Intelligence Committee (2019–2023) and was the lead manager in Trump's first impeachment trial; he has been a U.S. senator from California since December 2024. In 2025 the Trump administration's housing finance chief referred him to the Justice Department over alleged mortgage fraud, which Schiff denies and calls political; no charges had been reported by late 2025.

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: Schiff led the House managers in Trump's first impeachment trial (2020). In 2025 Trump called him a "scam artist" after FHFA director Bill Pulte referred Schiff to the Justice Department over alleged mortgage fraud; Schiff denies wrongdoing.

connections.name: Nancy Pelosi
connections.description: Pelosi named Schiff to the Benghazi select committee and, on January 15, 2020, lead manager for Trump's first impeachment; she endorsed him for the Senate in 2023.

connections.name: Joe Biden
connections.description: Schiff publicly called on Biden to end his reelection bid on July 17, 2024; Biden later pre-emptively pardoned him and the other members of the January 6 committee in January 2025.

connections.name: Bill Pulte
connections.description: As FHFA director, Pulte sent a criminal referral in May 2025 alleging Schiff claimed two primary residences on mortgage applications; Schiff denies wrongdoing.
